title: Atlas source manifest
description: Per-source catalogue metadata. Hand-authored after bootstrap; ingest runs do not modify. Validated by check-manifests.sh in CI.

source_id.description: Folder name and primary key. Lowercase slug.

upstream_id.description: The upstream's own identifier (SSB table number, FHI dataset slug, etc.).

upstream_url.description: Link to the data — typically the API endpoint Atlas's ingest module fetches.

upstream_landing_page.description: Optional human-browsable page describing the dataset (DCAT-AP dcat:landingPage). Falls back to upstream_url when absent.

upstream_title.description: The source's authoritative title at the upstream (usually Norwegian).

description.description: One paragraph for the customer-facing catalogue.

publisher.description: Institution that publishes the data. Must resolve against publishers.yaml display_name.

license.description: License token. NLOD for Norwegian public-sector sources by default.

license_url.description: URL to license terms, or 'internal' for private sources.

eu_theme.description: EU Data Theme code (DCAT-AP). 13 buckets defined by the EU Publications Office.

attribution.description: Attribution string displayed alongside data from this source.

provider.description: Provider slug (ssb, fhi, bufdir, redcross, …). Cross-referenced via publishers.yaml.

topic.description: Primary topic slug for navigation. Must resolve against source-categories.yaml.

geo.description: Geographic resolution slug (kommune, fylke, bydel, national).

dimensions.description: Hand-authored editorial semantics for each dimension column.

raw_tables.description: Optional explicit list of raw.* tables this source owns. Default is underscore-translated source_id.

lifecycle.description: Product status. stable = in production; beta = newly added or under review; deprecated = scheduled for removal; broken = ingest failing, do not consume.

start.description: 4-digit start year of available data. null for irregular cadences.

end.description: 4-digit end year (inclusive). null for irregular cadences.

keywords.description: Free-form multi-label keywords for facet / cross-listing. 3–6 recommended.

suggested_joins.description: Other source_ids that pair naturally with this source. Editorial; supplements auto-inferred joins from shared dimension codes.

sample_query.description: Optional PostgREST URL returning real rows. Falls back to a primary-key-templated default at build time.

methodology_notes.description: Markdown. Methodology context that doesn't fit in `description` — rolling averages, definition caveats, sampling notes, etc.

feedback_url.description: Optional override of publishers.yaml feedback_url for this specific dataset.
